products.title: BALMM Silicone Cloud Placemat – BPA-Free Foldable Kids Mat 48x27cm
products.body_html:
BALMM Silicone Cloud Placemat for Kids

The BALMM Silicone Cloud Placemat provides a safe, practical surface for your child's meals. Made from 100% food-grade, BPA-free silicone, this cloud-shaped mat protects tables and high chair trays while keeping dishes stable during mealtime.

Key Features

* Cloud-shaped design – 48x27cm mat adds visual appeal to mealtime

* Foldable construction – compact storage and portable for travel

* Non-slip surface – silicone grip keeps plates and cups in place

* Food-grade material – BPA-free silicone safe for direct food contact

* Heat-resistant – withstands hot dishes and temperature changes

* Waterproof – quick cleanup with warm soapy water

How to Use

1. Unfold the placemat and place on dining table or high chair tray

2. Position your child's plate, cup, and utensils on the mat

3. After meals, rinse or wipe clean with warm soapy water

4. Fold flat for storage in drawers, bags, or cabinets

Specifications

* Material: 100% food-grade, BPA-free silicone

* Dimensions: 48x27cm (cloud shape)

* Style: Foldable, non-slip silicone placemat

* Colors: Mist Gray, Sky Blue, and Blush Pink

* Suitable for: Babies, toddlers, and young children

* Hygienic surface for daily meal use

* Non-slip and waterproof design reduces spills and messes

* Cloud shape makes mealtime more engaging for children

* Easy maintenance – folds flat and cleans quickly

* Durable silicone resists wear from daily use

The BALMM Silicone Cloud Placemat combines functionality with child-friendly design, offering a reliable, easy-to-clean surface that protects your table while providing a stable eating area for your child.

products.title: USBETTAS Disposable Baby Placemats 50pk - Oil-Proof Adhesive
products.body_html:
USBETTAS Disposable Baby Placemats offer parents a convenient, hygienic, and mess-free solution for mealtime at home or on the go. Designed for easy cleanup and everyday practicality, these oil-proof table covers keep your baby's eating area clean and germ-free anywhere you dine.

Smart Design Features

Oil-proof and waterproof material keeps tables clean and dry during meals

Strong adhesive backing secures placemats firmly to tables and highchair trays

Disposable design eliminates the need for washing or sanitizing

Compact and lightweight for easy storage in diaper bags or travel kits

Baby-safe, BPA-free materials ensure safe contact with food

Colorful, fun patterns keep little ones engaged during mealtime

Setup and Usage

1. Remove a placemat from the package and unfold it completely.

2. Peel off the adhesive strips and stick the mat securely to a clean, flat surface.

3. Place baby food, snacks, or utensils directly on the mat.

4. After use, simply lift and discard—no cleanup required.

5. Store remaining placemats in a cool, dry place for next use.

Product Specifications

Material: BPA-free, food-safe plastic

Dimensions: 43x30cm per placemat

Style: Disposable, oil-proof, adhesive-backed table covers

Colors/Designs: Assorted fun prints for babies and toddlers

Suitable for: Home dining, restaurants, picnics, and travel

Why Choose These Placemats

Perfect for travel and dining out – lightweight, portable, and hygienic

Oil-proof protection prevents messy spills and stains

Safe and non-toxic materials ideal for everyday baby use

Quick cleanup saves time for busy parents

Cute designs make mealtime fun and stress-free
